description: This file defines a SwiftUI ViewModifier called GatewayTrustPromptAlert that presents an alert prompting the user to trust a gateway connection, including the SHA-256 fingerprint verification. It also extends View with a convenience method to apply this modifier.

classes.name: GatewayTrustPromptAlert
classes.description: A SwiftUI ViewModifier that shows a trust prompt alert for gateway connections, allowing users to accept or decline trusting the gateway.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Builds the modified view with an alert bound to the trust prompt state.

methods.name: gatewayTrustPromptAlert
methods.description: Extension method on View to apply the GatewayTrustPromptAlert modifier.
